coefficient_ratio_artifact_excluded.note: 1/(2 pi alpha)=21.81 units artifact (DERIVE-2 flag-don't-fix); NOT a physical EH coefficient; excluded from the physical band.

signal_vs_field.caption: Realized polarimeter ellipticity vs peak field at the sweet-spot geometry (g=7.9e-04, F=1e+03, lambda=1064 nm, L=1 cm). AVE and QED are co-computed through the IDENTICAL induced_ellipticity machinery (no-strawman R1); the legs differ ONLY in the index-shift coefficient. AVE sits a field-independent factor 4.14e+06 above QED across the swept field range. Both polarimetry floors (optimistic 1e-11 rad, realistic 1e-09 rad) shown.

window_E_vs_g.caption: Divergence window in the (peak field, geometry coupling g) plane at F=1e+03, lambda=1064 nm, L=1 cm. Coloured cells are IN-WINDOW: psi_AVE clears the realistic polarimetry floor (1e-09 rad), exceeds its co-computed QED counterpart, and stays inside the small-angle linearization (<0.1 rad). 35 of 72 (E, g) cells at this slice are in-window; the window includes the g=1e-03 worst-case. Cell colour is the field-independent AVE/QED ratio (uniform across the window — g cancels in the ratio).

time_to_5sigma.caption: Shot-noise-limited time to 5-sigma AVE detection vs peak field, across the geometry-coupling tiers g in [1e-08, 1e-03] (F=1e+03, lambda=1064 nm, L=1 cm, 1 W probe). The fastest in-grid detection is 4.04e-23 s at E=3.0e+16 V/m, g=1.0e-03. g sets the absolute signal (and hence integration time); it does NOT change the AVE/QED coefficient ratio.
